This is directly consequential for the near-twin comparison with #03: the same architecture with Parfum at rank 10 there gives a nine-entry credited segment and two above-tail humectants, while the preservative-first ordering here gives an eleven-entry segment and three. See AP-03-TWINS and AP-10-CRITERION2.  ||  PLAUSIBILITY ASSESSMENT (R2, §3.1.1, added under v0.2): PLAUSIBLE. CETEARYL ALCOHOL @2, the four-lipid block @4/@5/@6/@7, CETRIMONIUM CHLORIDE @8 and BEHENTRIMONIUM METHOSULFATE @10 all outrank SODIUM BENZOATE @12; conventional O/W emulsion with AQUA @1. adjudicationPoints.title: CLOSED by E10 (2026-09-30) — a moisture secondary may attach under a `general` fallback primary; secondary_focus becomes [`moisture`]
adjudicationPoints.body: Raised under v0.2: R5's lipid-led disqualifier is headline-scoped, and this product's cluster (GLYCERIN @3, BETAINE @9, PANTHENOL @11) meets criterion 1, but the record refused the secondary slot on the reading that §9.5.3 criterion 3's secondary path is written only for a RICHER winning route, not for the step-8 `general` fallback. Nick ruled E10 on 2026-09-30: the disqualifier is headline-only exactly as ruled, and a moisture secondary MAY attach under a `general` primary provided the cluster independently meets criterion 1. §9.5.2's secondary rule is amended accordingly. Primary stays `general`; secondary becomes [`moisture`] at `moderate` confidence, capped because PANTHENOL @11 is a load-bearing tail_index − 1 species (E1; `boundary_position_ingredient` emitted). Nothing further is needed from Nick on this record.
